units.title: 给爷爷打电话时说清楚

materials.title: Grandpa Phone Call 020
materials.text: A child calls Grandpa. Grandpa cannot hear well when there is noise. Choose the sentence that helps in each situation.

questions.prompt: The television is loud beside you. You want Grandpa to hear. What do you say to Dad?
questions.explanation: A调低背景声帮助通话；B更响相反；C把电话放外不解决与爷爷交流。

questions.prompt: Grandpa did not hear your meeting time. What do you say?
options: I will not tell you again.
I said three o’clock. Three o’clock.
questions.explanation: B清楚重复具体时刻；A拒重复、C沙发色均不澄清时间。

questions.prompt: You cannot hear Grandpa’s last words. What do you ask?
options: Could you say that again, please?
questions.explanation: C礼貌请求重说未听清内容；A帽、B鞋均无关听漏话。

questions.prompt: Grandpa thinks you will come today, but you mean tomorrow. What do you say?
options: I do not have a pencil.
questions.explanation: A明确纠正日期误解；B继续今日错误；C铅笔无关。

questions.prompt: You must end the call because dinner is ready. What do you say?
questions.explanation: B说明结束原因并告别；A藏电话不礼貌说明；C永久禁食不合。

units.title: 陶土杯晾干时的姓名牌

materials.title: Pottery Name Tags 020
materials.text: Our clay cups are soft. Leave them on the drying shelf. Put a name card beside each cup, not inside it. Do not lift a cup by its handle yet. The teacher moves the shelf. If two cards get mixed up, ask their owners before changing them. Paint the cups next week, after they are dry.

questions.prompt: A friend wants to carry a soft cup by its handle. You say, "____"
options: Leave the soft cup on the shelf.
questions.explanation: B软杯留架且暂不提把；A更拉、C装水均非晾干步骤。

questions.prompt: A friend drops the name card into the wet cup. You say, "____"
options: Put the card beside the cup.
questions.explanation: C名牌旁边非杯内；A违inside禁限；B把上未安排。

questions.prompt: A friend starts to push the drying shelf. You say, "____"
options: Let the teacher move the shelf.
Put the shelf on the cups.
questions.explanation: A架由教师移动；B学生推动到场外、C架压杯均不合。

questions.prompt: Two name cards are mixed up. Your friend guesses. You say, "____"
questions.explanation: B先问主人核对再换；A瞎猜、C丢杯都非解决方式。

questions.prompt: A friend wants to paint a soft cup today. You say, "____"
options: Wait until next week when it is dry.
questions.explanation: C下周干后上色；A今天、B保湿均违干燥条件。

materials.title: Umbrella Shadow Sun 020
materials.text: It is sunny and hot. Mum opens an umbrella at the bus stop. My brother says, "But there is no rain!" Mum asks him to stand under it. He feels cooler in the shade. I can see a round dark patch on the ground. A dog lies at the edge of it. When the bus comes, Mum closes the umbrella before we get on.

questions.prompt: It is raining at the bus stop.
questions.explanation: B正确：sunny hot且no rain；A把雨伞存在当正在下雨。

questions.prompt: The umbrella gives the family shade.
questions.explanation: A正确：under umbrella feels cooler in shade；B否认用途。

questions.prompt: The dark patch on the ground is square.
questions.explanation: B正确：round dark patch；A圆改方。

questions.prompt: A dog lies at the edge of the shade.
questions.explanation: A正确：dog edge of it指阴影；B否认位置。

questions.prompt: Mum closes the umbrella before boarding the bus.
questions.explanation: A正确：before get on关闭；B否认先后。

materials.title: Cardboard Boat Captain 020
materials.text: My sister makes a boat from a big cardboard box. She puts a chair inside and calls it the captain’s seat. I make a paper hat for her. Our little brother brings a toy fish. He wants to put water in the box, but we say it must stay dry. We put blue cloth around the boat instead. Then we pretend to sail to an island under the dining table.

questions.prompt: The pretend boat is made from cardboard.
questions.explanation: A正确：big cardboard box成船；B否认材料。

questions.prompt: The chair stands outside the boat.
questions.explanation: B正确：chair inside；A内外反向。

questions.prompt: The little brother brings a toy fish.
questions.explanation: A正确：brings toy fish；B否认道具。

questions.prompt: The children fill the cardboard box with water.
questions.explanation: B正确：必须干，不加水；A把未采纳想法当行动。

questions.prompt: Blue cloth is used around the boat.
questions.explanation: A正确：blue cloth around instead；B否认替代造景方式。

materials.title: Classroom Door Hinge 020
materials.text: Our classroom door makes a loud noise when it opens. It interrupts the quiet reading time. We first ask people to keep the door shut, but late pupils still need to come in. The caretaker checks the hinges. He asks us to use the other door while he works. After he finishes, the door opens quietly. We remove the temporary sign from the other door. The teacher says the problem was with the door, not with pupils who needed to enter.

questions.prompt: What problem does the class have?
questions.explanation: A开门响打断静读；B无书、C缺墙均未提。

questions.prompt: Why is keeping the door shut not a full solution?
options: Late pupils still need to enter.
The caretaker wants to read outside.
questions.explanation: B迟到学生仍需进；A教室有人；C管理员意图未提。

questions.prompt: Where do pupils enter while repairs happen?
questions.explanation: C维修时另一门；A窗、B墙无此路线。

questions.prompt: What happens after the repair?
questions.explanation: A修后静开；B永久停读、C拆双门均非结果。

questions.prompt: What does the teacher emphasise?
options: The door itself caused the problem.
Every late pupil made the hinges.
questions.explanation: B不是需要进的孩子问题，而门故障；A永不进、C孩子造铰链无据。

materials.title: Holiday Pet Note 020
materials.text: Our neighbour asks us to feed her goldfish for two days. Her note says to give one small spoon of food each morning. We must not feed them again in the evening. On the first day, my brother thinks the fish still look hungry. Mum points to the note and puts the food tin away. We mark the morning feeding on the calendar. When the neighbour returns, she can see that both mornings have been recorded.

questions.prompt: The family looks after the fish for two days.
questions.explanation: A正确：for two days；B否认照看时长。

questions.prompt: The note says to feed one small spoon each morning.
questions.explanation: A正确：one small spoon every morning；B否认份量和频率。

questions.prompt: The brother’s guess leads the family to feed again that evening.
questions.explanation: B正确：妈妈按便条收食，未晚间再喂；A把猜测当后续行动。

questions.prompt: The family records feeding on a calendar.
questions.explanation: A正确：mark morning feeding calendar；B否认记录方法。

questions.prompt: The neighbour finds only one morning recorded after returning.
questions.explanation: B正确：both mornings recorded；A把两次改一次。

materials.title: Knitting Row Story 020
materials.text:
Mara knitted a scarf for her little brother with Grandma’s help. Near the end, she noticed one narrow row where she had used fewer stitches. She wanted to hide it inside the folded scarf. Grandma suggested asking whether the scarf still worked and whether the mistake should be fixed. Together they checked the loose thread. It could be secured, but the narrow row would remain unless several rows were undone.
Mara’s brother tried the scarf. He liked the soft wool and said the narrow part fitted neatly under his coat. Mara told him how it had happened instead of pretending it was planned. He asked her to keep it as it was. They secured the thread together. Later, Mara practised counting stitches on a small sample. Accepting this scarf did not mean she had stopped wanting to improve.

questions.prompt: What does Mara notice?
options: The whole scarf belongs to Grandma.
questions.explanation: B一行针数少而窄；A材质变化、C归属、D全不喜欢均无据。

questions.prompt: What is Grandma’s first suggestion?
options: Check how the scarf works and what needs fixing.
questions.explanation: C一起检查功能与处理；A扔、B藏、D不看就拆非建议。

questions.prompt: Why is the narrow row kept?
options: The brother finds it useful and asks to keep it.
It cannot be seen by anyone at all.
The scarf is only for a museum.
questions.explanation: A试戴适合外套且弟弟要求保留；B已可见；C可修线；D无博物馆。

questions.prompt: How does Mara describe the narrow row to her brother?
options: She says it was a secret professional pattern.
She tells him what actually happened.
questions.explanation: D如实说明非计划；A/C掩饰、B推责均非行为。

questions.prompt: What does Mara do later?
options: Practise counting stitches on a sample.
Ask the brother never to wear it.
questions.explanation: B另样练计针；A放弃、C隐藏、D禁穿与末段相反。

units.title: 社区借物台的两个归还口

materials.title: Community Desk Return Slots 020
materials.text: The community desk lent board games and small sports kits. A sign directed books to a narrow return slot and games to a staffed counter. One visitor put a game box through the book slot. Several pieces fell out inside. Staff found them, but they could not tell which set they belonged to immediately. The desk changed its sign to include the reason: boxes could open and loose pieces needed checking. It also placed a large arrow towards the game counter. The book slot stayed open after hours, but games still had to be returned while a helper was present. A later opening time was added on Thursday for people who worked during the day.

questions.prompt: Games were meant to be returned through the narrow book slot.
questions.explanation: B正确：游戏有人柜台，书才窄槽；A用途交换。

questions.prompt: Loose pieces made it harder to identify the correct set.
questions.explanation: A正确：散落后不能立即分套；B否认问题。

questions.prompt: The revised sign explained why games needed the counter.
questions.explanation: A正确：盒会开、散件需核为理由；B否认补充解释。

questions.prompt: Games could be returned unattended at any hour after the change.
questions.explanation: B正确：仍需helper在；A把书槽全天当游戏全天。

questions.prompt: Thursday gained a later staffed opening time.
questions.explanation: A正确：later opening Thursday供日间工作者；B否认便利改进。

units.title: 河边步道上留下的旧箭头

materials.title: River Sign Story 020
materials.text:
After a flood, a village walking path changed. The wooden bridge near the mill had been removed, and walkers had to use a wider bridge upstream. Sora helped paint a new direction sign. She wanted to cover every old arrow at once so no one would be confused.
Her aunt stopped her beside a stone wall. One faded arrow pointed to the old mill path, which was still open for visitors who wanted to see the building. It was the river crossing beyond the mill that was closed. If Sora painted over the arrow without replacing its message, people might think the mill itself was closed too.
They made the signs more precise: one showed the mill entrance, another marked the closed crossing, and a third directed walkers upstream. They checked the route from a newcomer’s point of view before leaving. Sora learned that correcting information did not always mean erasing everything old. It meant finding exactly which part had changed and making the remaining choices clear.

questions.prompt: What had the flood changed?
options: The availability of one bridge crossing.
questions.explanation: B磨坊旁木桥移除需上游桥；A无改名；C全村楼、D所有路永闭均夸大。

questions.prompt: Why does Sora’s aunt question covering the faded arrow?
options: It still leads to an open mill path.
The old bridge is definitely open.
questions.explanation: C箭头仍可指开放磨坊；A/B无据；D过河段确闭。

questions.prompt: Which place remains open?
options: A secret path across the water.
questions.explanation: A可到磨坊建筑；B木桥已撤；C全部水道、D秘密涉水路未提。

questions.prompt: How do they check the revised signs?
options: Ask only whether the paint looks bright.
Erase all choices from the wall.
Follow the route as if they were newcomers.
questions.explanation: D以新来者视角走查；A仅亮色、B不查、C删全部均非方法。

questions.prompt: What does Sora learn?
options: Old information must always remain unchanged.
A correction should identify the part that actually changed.
questions.explanation: B精准指出变化保留有效选择；A拒改、C全废、D靠猜均与主旨相反。

units.title: 保温盒比较里的开盖次数

materials.title: Lunchbox Temperature Record 020
materials.text:
For a class investigation, pupils compared two insulated lunchboxes using warm water. Both began with the same amount of water at the same temperature. One group opened Box A every five minutes to look inside. The other left Box B closed until the end. Box B’s water stayed warmer. Some pupils wanted to say this proved its material was better.
The teacher asked them to list every difference in the method. Opening a box repeatedly could let heat escape, so the test had not compared materials alone. The class repeated the trial with matching opening times. They kept the first table and added a note about the unequal opening pattern. Their final report used the second trial for the material comparison and showed why the first one was limited.

questions.prompt: The boxes started with equal water amounts and temperatures.
questions.explanation: A正确：same amount same temperature；B否认起始控制。

questions.prompt: Both boxes were opened equally often in the first trial.
questions.explanation: B正确：A每五分开、B末次才开；A忽略程序差异。

questions.prompt: Box B’s warmer result alone proved its material was better.
questions.explanation: B正确：开盖次数不同可散热，不能只归材料；A越过证据边界。

questions.prompt: The repeated trial used matching opening times.
questions.explanation: A正确：matching opening times；B否认改进条件。

questions.prompt: The class kept the first table with a note explaining its limit.
questions.explanation: A正确：kept first table note unequal pattern；B否认保留异常试验。
